item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 30/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine weather to southern China in the next few days, but showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. The northeast monsoon will also affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days, it will be windier over region. Tropical Cyclone Koinu is expected to move towards the vicinity of the Luzon Strait to Taiwan early to midweek next week. It may then enter the northeastern part of the South China Sea and have a chance to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week. Besides, another surge of the northeast monsoon will reach southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, there are uncertainties in Koinu’s subsequent movement and intensity.
